map.第一行\n第二行\n第三行\n第四行\n第五行:
First line
Second line
Third line
Fourth line
Fifth line
map.同时反转每行字符: Also reverse characters in each line
map.倒序输出：把末行置顶、首行置底，适合日志从新到旧展示。: Reverse output: put the last line on top and the first at the bottom, ideal for showing logs newest-first.
map.栈式回放：按后进先出查看列表。: Stack-style playback: view a list last-in-first-out.
map.数据翻转：配合排序做降序排列的替代方案。: Data flip: an alternative to descending sort when combined with sorting.
map.日志倒序看最新: View newest logs by reversing order
map.粘贴 100 行日志，行反转后第 100 行（最新）变第 1 行，便于先看最近事: Paste 100 log lines; after reversal line 100 (newest) becomes line 1, so you see recent events first; in-line text stays the same, only order flips.
map.文本反转把整段当一串字符倒序（含行内），本工具只颠倒行顺序、保留每行内容，更适合: Text Reverser reverses the whole block as one character string (including within lines); this tool only flips line order while keeping each line intact, better for logs and lists.
map.空行也作为一行参与反转；若想忽略空行请先去空白。: Blank lines also take part in the reversal as a line; to ignore them, remove blanks first.
map.按 \\n 切分为行数组；可选对每行去首尾空白。若保留首行则取下标 0 原样置于: Split into an array of lines by \n; optionally trim each line. If keep-first is on, take index 0 unchanged and place it at the start of the result; if keep-last is on, take the last line unchanged and place it at the end; only the middle part is reversed. When skipping blank lines: record the indexes of blank lines first, reverse the non-blank lines, then put the blank lines back at their original indexes; otherwise reverse the whole array. Optionally reverse characters within each line (blank lines skipped), join the output with \n, and show "(no content)" when the result is empty
